descriptionChirho: To restore something or someone to a previous condition, whether physical healing (a withered hand restored: Matt 12:13, Mark 3:5, Mark 8:25, Luke 6:10), eschatological restoration (Elijah restoring all things: Matt 17:11, Mark 9:12), the anticipated restoration of the kingdom to Israel (Acts 1:6), or personal restoration (Paul requesting prayer to be restored to the Hebrews: Heb 13:19). Multilingual glosses consistently render as 'restore/return' (arb: رُدَّت, heb: שָׁבָה/הוּשָׁבָה, kor: 회복, spa: restaurar, fra: retablir).
